#!/usr/bin/env Rscript # PCA analysis of gene counts colored by condition # Loads gene counts from nfcore-rnaseq and design metadata # Performs variance-stabilizing transformation and PCA visualization library(DESeq2) library(tidyverse) library(ggplot2) # Resolve artifact paths counts_path <- "../../../02_bioinformatics/rnaseq_bulk/01_nfcore-rnaseq-wrapper/run/results/star_salmon/salmon.merged.gene_counts_length_scaled.tsv" design_path <- "../../../01_samplesheets/rnaseq_bulk_design.csv" message("Loading counts from: ", counts_path) message("Loading design from: ", design_path) # Load gene counts counts_data <- read.table(counts_path, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = "\t") counts_matrix <- as.matrix(counts_data) # Load design design <- read.csv(design_path, row.names = 1) # Variance-stabilizing transformation vst_data <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds) vst_matrix <- assay(vst_data) # Identify top 500 variable genes gene_vars <- rowVars(vst_matrix) top_genes <- order(gene_vars, decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(500, nrow(vst_matrix))] vst_top <- vst_matrix[top_genes, ] #
